cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Confess Around Them
cards.instruction: Use partial admissions to make a reciprocal confession feel like the only missing piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I changed the meeting time to three. Let's reconstruct it accurately: what happened to the room booking?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You changed the time without telling me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I left that out of the message. Put both of my changes in the first column; the room column is still blank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I moved us upstairs because the old room was booked at three.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then enter who received that message. Mine had a time and no room; please show me where your room notice went so we can finish the two columns.

heightening.evidence: A5 pressures the remaining notice but rests on a changed account of A's message.

specificity.evidence: A3 omitted time and A5 time-in-message conflict; B4 new-three knowledge not established.
